svg.title: Blue Jay Night Ride project map
svg.desc: One-page project map for Team FourSight. Top to bottom: the abandoned 15 Sep proposal, the 28-30 Sep pivot, then five stages left to right: Digitize and Analyze (done), Build the world (next), Simulate and compare, Recommend and report (planned). A footer lists the documents and governance in place. Color is status and every box also states its status in words.

g.text: THEN · Proposal, 15 Sep · ABANDONED 28 Sep: the trip-level data never came; only the aggregate April report did
